# SoulCause

> Evangelism consulting that helps churches return to the Great Commission by equipping the few, sending the many and multiplying disciples to the world. Founded by Rev. Danny DuVall, an Assemblies of God minister, teaching pastor and speaker who co-founded Christian Life Church in Birmingham, Alabama, in 1995.

SoulCause follows the sending model of Jesus: the twelve (Matthew 10), the seventy (Luke 10), then the world (Acts 1:8).

## Plans

- **SEND** (The 12 · Matthew 10): For the core team inside one church. Begin with a sending assessment, agree on a 90-day plan and send your first twelve. Price: $49 per month.
- **LABOR** (The 70 · Luke 10): For churches and networks training labourers and sending them two by two into every place. Price: $49 per month.
- **REACH** (The world · Acts 1:8): For denominations, networks and ministries carrying the Great Commission across regions and nations. Price: Starting at $150.
- **NET** (Services · Luke 5:4): Networks, events and training: consulting delivered in print, in person, virtually or fully outsourced. Price: Starting at $150.
- **FIELD** (The app · John 4:35): The SoulCause app: assessment, agreed plan, assigned actions, connected tools and adviser review in one place. Price: $12 per month.

- [Home](https://soulcause.com/): plans, the harvest-field region explorer and the founder

## Notes

- SoulCause measures faithfulness, never a scoreboard of souls.
- SoulCause does not give legal, tax or HR advice.
